items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I haven't heard Euston's band in a long time... I don't know what style they're playing on now.

ctx.x: I haven't heard Euston's band in a long time. Mm-hmm. I don't know what style they're playing on now. And I don't know how they sound.
Well, Larry's band is still up, huh? Larry's band is up.
Mm-hmm. And they play a lot of rock and roll. Mm-hmm. I haven't heard them.
